entries.officialDescription: You burst with Moglin spirit! Deals damage and applies buffs to you for each target hit, in the following order:

Deals damage and applies buffs to you for each target hit, in the following order: Pirate: +30% Haste Frogzard: +80% Hit Chance Quibble: +10% Luck Paladin: +20% Damage Resistance Dricken +20% outgoing damage Effects last 20 seconds.

entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 4 targets.
entries.officialDescription: The Dark Moglin Arts have been unleashed! Randomly applies up to 4 different evil Moglin Auras for each target hit.
entries.evidence: Moglin Menace Rank Needed: 2 Mana Cost: 10 Mana Cooldown: 6 Seconds Type: Magical Range: An infinite range status skill that applies to 4 targets. Zorbak: DoT (50%, doesn't stack) Legion: +5% outgoing damage, stacks to 7 (80%) Mort: +7% Dodge, stacks to 7 (80%) Memet: +20% Crit Chance (50%) Effects last for 20 seconds.

entries.target: An infinite range skill that heals 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Your Moglins heal you and up to 6 allies, then apply buffs in the following order:
entries.evidence: Moglin Life Rank Needed: 3 Mana Cost: 30 Mana Cooldown: 8 Seconds Type: Magical Range: An infinite range skill that heals 7 friendly targets. Description: Your Moglins heal you and up to 6 allies, then apply buffs in the following order: Twilly: +20% Endurance for you and all allies Twig: HoT for you and all allies Cupcake: -25% mana costs for you and all allies Effects last for 20 seconds. If used out of combat, while you don't have a pet equipped, will summon Twilly. Note: Summons Twilly Temporary Battlepet.
